title: 小林一茶の俳句 (Haiku by Kobayashi Issa)
description: Five famous haiku by Kobayashi Issa (1763–1828), the poet of the small and overlooked. Orphaned young and sent from home as a child laborer, Issa wrote with unusual tenderness toward sparrows, frogs, and children — the weak things of the world. His verses speak in plain, warm language that N5 learners can begin to feel.
author: 小林一茶 (Kobayashi Issa, 1763–1828)
